preconditions.description: The length of string s is not greater than 10^6 characters.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of each query string xi is less than or equal to 10^6 characters.

preconditions.expression: All characters in s and xi are lowercase English letters.
preconditions.description: The strings s and xi only consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: For each query xi, the output should be the number of consecutive substrings of s that are cyclical isomorphic to xi.
